name: What should I look for in a company that offers engineering coordination services?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a company that offers engineering coordination services?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a company for engineering coordination, look for a proven track record in luxury home construction, demonstrated experience with complex projects, and strong communication skills. They should have a deep understanding of various engineering disciplines, familiarity with local building codes, and a collaborative approach to working with architects, engineers, and contractors. References and examples of successfully completed integrated projects are also key indicators of expertise.
